title: Beef Stew Norwegian Style
description: A hearty beef stew inspired by traditional Norwegian cuisine, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion, carrot, and celery to pot and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, whisking constantly.
Return beef to pot and add red wine if using.
Bring stew to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
